day3_start.name: Me
day3_start.text: *The alarm goes off. Third morning. Life at this school is starting to feel almost routine.*

day3_nurse_home_morning.name: Me
day3_nurse_home_morning.text: *...I open my eyes. Unfamiliar ceiling. Oh, right. Here.*

day3_nurse_home_morning_2.name: Me
day3_nurse_home_morning_2.text: *Fragments of last night drift through my head. Her perfume, that soft voice, and...*

day3_nurse_home_morning_3.name: Nurse
day3_nurse_home_morning_3.text: "Oh my, you're up already? You were out cold last night~ Hehe."

day3_nurse_home_morning_4.name: Me
day3_nurse_home_morning_4.text: *She hands me a cup of coffee. Her smile in the morning light is almost blinding.*
choices: *Takes the coffee but can't make eye contact*

day3_nurse_home_morning_thanks.name: Nurse
day3_nurse_home_morning_thanks.text: "Hehe, being all polite is no fun, is it? Not between us~"

day3_nurse_home_morning_bold.name: Nurse
day3_nurse_home_morning_bold.text: "My... throwing down the gauntlet this early? I didn't mind it either."

day3_nurse_home_morning_shy.name: Nurse
day3_nurse_home_morning_shy.text: "Aww, how cute. The shy look is quite endearing, you know?"

day3_nurse_home_morning_leave.name: Nurse
day3_nurse_home_morning_leave.text: "Now then, go get ready. If we run into each other at school... we're strangers. Got it?"

day3_nurse_home_morning_leave_2.name: Me
day3_nurse_home_morning_leave_2.text: *Leaving her sly wink behind me, I hurried out the door.*

day3_nurse_home_school_arrival.name: Me
day3_nurse_home_school_arrival.text: *Arrived at school. The morning air feels strangely refreshing. Nobody knows, right?*

day3_nurse_home_suspicion.name: Seoyeon
day3_nurse_home_suspicion.text: "Hey, {name}. Good morning... but you came from a different direction than usual, didn't you? I've got sharp eyes, you know."

day3_nurse_home_suspicion_2.name: Me
day3_nurse_home_suspicion_2.text: *Seoyeon's gaze is like a laser. I need to come up with something.*
choices: "Oh, I was just out for a walk and..."

day3_nurse_home_lie.name: Seoyeon
day3_nurse_home_lie.text: "...A walk? At dawn? How healthy of you. I don't know what you were up to, but sure."

day3_nurse_home_half_lie.name: Seoyeon
day3_nurse_home_half_lie.text: "...A relative? What kind of relative? A woman, by any chance?"

day3_nurse_home_stutter.name: Seoyeon
day3_nurse_home_stutter.text: "...Why won't you look at me? You're hiding something. I can tell."

day3_nurse_home_yuna_appears_2.name: Me
day3_nurse_home_yuna_appears_2.text: *Yuna's nose twitches slightly. That look in her eyes... it's genuinely sharp.*

day3_nurse_home_tension.name: Seoyeon
day3_nurse_home_tension.text: "...Wait. Perfume? If you didn't put it on yourself, then whose side were you at last night, exactly?"

day3_nurse_home_tension_2.name: Me
day3_nurse_home_tension_2.text: *The air freezes. I need to get out of here.*
choices: "Oh, I'm gonna be late for class! Gotta go!"
"It's a misunderstanding, I was at a family friend's place..."

day3_nurse_home_escape.name: Me
day3_nurse_home_escape.text: *I sprint toward the classroom at full speed. Their stares pierce my back like arrows.*

day3_nurse_home_excuse.name: Seoyeon
day3_nurse_home_excuse.text: "...A family friend? Then why are you being so squirrely about it?"

day3_nurse_home_excuse_2.name: Me
day3_nurse_home_excuse_2.text: *Seoyeon's eyes narrow. Time to retreat to the classroom.*

day3_start_2.name: Me
day3_start_2.text: *Bright light outside the window. It's already Friday. What should I do this weekend?*

day3_start_3.name: Me
day3_start_3.text: *I check my phone. There are some unread messages.*

day3_msg_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day3_msg_seoyeon.text: *06:00* 'Good morning, {name}. Walk to school together? I'll wait outside your place. And no, I don't accept refusals.'

day3_msg_dain.name: Dain
day3_msg_dain.text: *07:05* 'Yahooo!! {name}!! Let's walk to school together!! Where's your house?! I'll run over!! ><'

day3_msg_nurse.name: Nurse
day3_msg_nurse.text: *23:47* 'Walk to school with me tomorrow? Just the two of us~'

day3_msg_teacher.name: Teacher
day3_msg_teacher.text: *22:30* '{name}, are you heading to school early tomorrow? I could use some company on the walk. No extra credit for this.'

day3_msg_response_first_teachers.name: Me
choices: Sorry, I'll head out alone today

day3_reject_msg_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day3_reject_msg_seoyeon.text: *Reply* '...Really? Too bad, I guess. See you at school.'

day3_reject_msg_dain.name: Dain
day3_reject_msg_dain.text: *Reply* 'Whaaaat?! Why?! Fine... see you at school!!'

day3_reject_msg_nurse.name: Nurse
day3_reject_msg_nurse.text: *Reply* 'Aww, that's too bad. See you at school then~'

day3_msg_seoyeon_after_reject.name: Seoyeon
day3_msg_seoyeon_after_reject.text: *06:00* 'Good morning, {name}. Walk to school together? I'll wait outside your place. And no, I don't accept refusals.'
choices: Walk with Seoyeon *I already turned her down though...*

day3_msg_yuna_after_reject.name: Yuna
choices: Walk with Yuna *I already turned her down though...*

day3_msg_dain_after_reject.name: Dain
day3_msg_dain_after_reject.text: *07:05* 'Yahooo!! {name}!! Let's walk to school together!! Where's your house?! I'll run over!! ><'
choices: Walk with Dain *I already turned her down though...*

day3_msg_nurse_after_reject.name: Nurse
day3_msg_nurse_after_reject.text: *23:47* 'Walk to school with me tomorrow? Just the two of us~'
choices: Walk with the Nurse *I already turned her down though...*

day3_msg_teacher_after_reject.name: Teacher
day3_msg_teacher_after_reject.text: *22:30* '{name}, are you heading to school early tomorrow? I could use some company on the walk. No extra credit for this.'
choices: Walk with Teacher *I already turned her down though...*

day3_change_mind.name: Me
day3_change_mind.text: *I send another message. 'Never mind what I said before, I want to go together!'*

day3_change_mind_teachers.name: Me
day3_change_mind_teachers.text: *I send another message. 'Actually, forget what I said earlier! I'd like to walk together after all!'*

day3_change_mind_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day3_change_mind_seoyeon.text: *Instant reply* 'Changed your mind? That's fine, I was planning to wait anyway. Hurry up.'

day3_change_mind_dain.name: Dain
day3_change_mind_dain.text: *Reply in 0.3 seconds* 'YESSS!! Leaving now!! Wait for me!!!!'

day3_change_mind_nurse.name: Nurse
day3_change_mind_nurse.text: *Reply* 'Hehe, so you can't resist me after all? Hurry up and get out here~'

day3_change_mind_teacher.name: Teacher
day3_change_mind_teacher.text: *Reply* 'Oh? Good. Hurry up and get ready.'

day3_walk_with_seoyeon_2.name: Seoyeon
day3_walk_with_seoyeon_2.text: "There you are. I said I don't accept refusals, and you actually showed up. How honest of you."

day3_walk_seoyeon_dream.name: Seoyeon
day3_walk_seoyeon_dream.text: *Walking side by side* "Hey, {name}. I had a dream last night."

day3_walk_seoyeon_dream_choice.name: Me
day3_walk_seoyeon_dream_choice.text: *Seoyeon brings up a dream out of nowhere.*

day3_walk_seoyeon_dream_ask.name: Seoyeon
day3_walk_seoyeon_dream_ask.text: *Seoyeon's ears turn red* "...Secret. I'm not telling. Shouldn't have asked."

day3_walk_seoyeon_dream_me.name: Seoyeon
day3_walk_seoyeon_dream_me.text: *Seoyeon stops in her tracks* "...Wow. The confidence on you. ...Not that you're wrong, though."

day3_walk_seoyeon_dream_bad.name: Seoyeon
day3_walk_seoyeon_dream_bad.text: *Seoyeon looks at me like I'm hopeless* "You really have a gift for killing the mood, don't you? It was a good dream, for the record."

day3_walk_seoyeon_crosswalk.name: Me
day3_walk_seoyeon_crosswalk.text: *Waiting at the crosswalk. Standing still, her hand is almost-but-not-quite touching mine.*

day3_walk_seoyeon_crosswalk_2.name: Me
day3_walk_seoyeon_crosswalk_2.text: *Seoyeon's pinky brushes the back of my hand. Our eyes meet, and we both look away at the same time.*

day3_walk_seoyeon_freetalk.name: Me
day3_walk_seoyeon_freetalk.text: *On the way to school, Seoyeon and I make small talk about this and that.*
day3_walk_seoyeon_freetalk.context: Walking to school with Seoyeon in the morning. Their hands just brushed at the crosswalk, so there's a subtle awareness between them. It's Friday morning, so the weekend might come up.
day3_walk_seoyeon_freetalk.personality: Seoyeon is the cool-beauty type. Sharp-tongued, composed, with a sly charm. She's possessive and bluntly direct when jealous.

day3_seoyeon_weekend_talk.name: Seoyeon
day3_seoyeon_weekend_talk.text: *As the school gate comes into view, Seoyeon casually brings it up* "...{name}. Are you free this weekend? There's a cafe I've been wanting to check out."

day3_seoyeon_weekend_ask.name: Seoyeon
day3_seoyeon_weekend_ask.text: "I bookmarked it on social media. Too good to waste going alone. Saturday, 2 PM, by the park fountain."

day3_seoyeon_weekend_tease.name: Seoyeon
day3_seoyeon_weekend_tease.text: *The tips of Seoyeon's ears go red* "...What kind of question is that? I didn't invite anyone else. Saturday, 2 PM, by the park fountain."

day3_seoyeon_weekend_direct.name: Seoyeon
day3_seoyeon_weekend_direct.text: *Seoyeon's lips curl into a smile* "...I'd say 'I don't accept refusals,' but. Saturday, 2 PM, by the park fountain."

day3_seoyeon_weekend_choice.name: Me
day3_seoyeon_weekend_choice.text: *Seoyeon's playing it cool, but there's the faintest waver in her eyes.*
choices: Got it. I'll definitely be there.
Let me think about it and get back to you.
Sorry, I'm kind of busy this weekend.

day3_seoyeon_weekend_yes.name: Seoyeon
day3_seoyeon_weekend_yes.text: *Seoyeon presses her lips together, then lets out a small grin* "...Good. Saturday, then. Be late and I'm leaving without you."

day3_seoyeon_weekend_later.name: Seoyeon
day3_seoyeon_weekend_later.text: *Seoyeon's smile stiffens slightly* "...Sure. Let me know."

day3_seoyeon_weekend_no.name: Seoyeon
day3_seoyeon_weekend_no.text: *Seoyeon pauses for a beat, then smiles* "...That so? Well, I can go by myself."

day3_walk_with_yuna.name: Me
day3_walk_with_yuna.text: *I headed toward the back gate. Yuna is standing under the shade of a tree.*

day3_walk_yuna_greet.name: Yuna
day3_walk_yuna_greet.text: "...You came. *walking quietly* Clear skies today. But... clear days are the most dangerous."

day3_walk_yuna_leaf.name: Me
day3_walk_yuna_leaf.text: *A leaf carried by the breeze lands on my head. Yuna wordlessly reaches out and picks it off.*

day3_walk_yuna_leaf_3.name: Me
day3_walk_yuna_leaf_3.text: *My heart skips at that single line from Yuna's expressionless face. She suddenly stops walking.*

day3_walk_yuna_necktie_2.name: Me
day3_walk_yuna_necktie_2.text: *Yuna starts fixing my tie. Her face is barely 10cm away.*

day3_walk_yuna_necktie_still.name: Yuna
day3_walk_yuna_necktie_still.text: "...Walking around with it this loose. Idiot."

day3_walk_yuna_necktie_cold.name: Yuna
day3_walk_yuna_necktie_cold.text: *Yuna's hands stop. A brief silence.* "...Want me to warm them up?"

day3_walk_yuna_freetalk.name: Me
day3_walk_yuna_freetalk.text: *Walking side by side toward school with Yuna. Neither of us says much, but it's not uncomfortable.*
day3_walk_yuna_freetalk.context: Walking to school with Yuna. She just fixed his tie, so the atmosphere is subtly charged. Quiet, but there's a closeness in the silence.
day3_walk_yuna_freetalk.personality: Yuna is languid, blunt, and marches to her own beat. She speaks in short, cryptic sentences. Cold on the surface, but there's a gap when she opens up.

day3_walk_yuna_talk.name: Yuna
day3_walk_yuna_talk.text: *On a quiet stretch of the road, Yuna suddenly speaks* "{name}. This weekend... there's a place I want to show only you."

day3_yuna_weekend_ask.name: Yuna
day3_yuna_weekend_ask.text: "...The real face of this school. Saturday, 8 PM, back gate. Don't be late. There are things you can only see in the dark."

day3_yuna_weekend_curious.name: Yuna
day3_yuna_weekend_curious.text: *Yuna smiles coldly* "It's not a secret. Closer to the truth. Saturday, 8 PM. Everything changes after sundown."

day3_yuna_weekend_direct.name: Yuna
day3_yuna_weekend_direct.text: *Yuna's eyes widen for a moment. A smile.* "...Knew I could count on you. Saturday, 8 PM, back gate. Be there."

day3_yuna_weekend_choice.name: Me
day3_yuna_weekend_choice.text: *Yuna's eyes are dead serious. 8 PM... something about this feels off.*
choices: Got it. I'll definitely be there.
Let me think about it and get back to you.
I have other plans this weekend.

day3_yuna_weekend_yes.name: Yuna
day3_yuna_weekend_yes.text: *Yuna lightly grabs my sleeve, then lets go* "...Thanks. You won't regret it."

day3_yuna_weekend_no.name: Yuna
day3_yuna_weekend_no.text: *Something goes cold in Yuna's eyes for a split second* "......Okay."

day3_walk_with_dain.name: Me
day3_walk_with_dain.text: *On my way to the meeting spot. In the distance, Dain waves both arms wildly while sprinting at full speed toward me.*

day3_walk_dain_bump_2.name: Me
day3_walk_dain_bump_2.text: *Dain shows no signs of stopping. There's no time to dodge── WHAM!!*

day3_walk_dain_bump_4.name: Me
day3_walk_dain_bump_4.text: *Dain has landed right on top of me. Our faces are 10cm apart. I can feel her breathing.*
choices: "I dunno, this is pretty comfortable. Should we stay like this?"

day3_walk_dain_help.name: Dain
day3_walk_dain_help.text: *I take her hand and pull her up. Dain's face turns beet red* "Th-thanks... my heart is! pounding because! we bumped into each other! That's the only reason, okay!!!"

day3_walk_dain_bold.name: Dain
day3_walk_dain_bold.text: "Huh?! ...Are you insane?! Get up right now!! People are watching!!"

day3_walk_dain_freeze.name: Dain
day3_walk_dain_freeze.text: "Hey, why are you just staring?! Whose face is red here! ...Mine too? Whatever, I don't care!!"

day3_walk_dain_greet_shy.name: Dain
day3_walk_dain_greet_shy.text: *Springs up and brushes off the dust* "...Dummy. Making me trip first thing in the morning."

day3_walk_dain_greet.name: Dain
day3_walk_dain_greet.text: *Clears her throat* "A-anyway! Let's go! The weather's perfect for exercise, don't you think?!"

day3_walk_dain_freetalk.name: Me
day3_walk_dain_freetalk.text: *Walking to school side by side with Dain. Maybe because of the collision earlier, she's keeping a little more distance than usual.*
day3_walk_dain_freetalk.context: Walking to school with Dain. They just had a tumbling incident so Dain is a bit flustered. Full of energy but occasionally blushing.
day3_walk_dain_freetalk.personality: Dain is a puppy-energy type who loves physical contact and is fiercely competitive. Exclamation mark machine. Tsundere. Upbeat on the outside, sensitive on the inside.

day3_walk_dain_talk.name: Dain
day3_walk_dain_talk.text: *Bouncing along* "Oh! Right, {name}! Tomorrow morning at 9, there's a practice match at the gym! Come cheer me on!!"
choices: Obviously! I'll be there for sure!

day3_dain_weekend_ask.name: Dain
day3_dain_weekend_ask.text: *Dain hops in place* "Really?! Awesome! Then after practice, let's go get tteokbokki!! My treat!!"

day3_dain_weekend_early.name: Dain
day3_dain_weekend_early.text: *Dain grins* "Honestly, I hate waking up early too! But if you're there, I get like a 200% power boost!"

day3_dain_weekend_hesitate.name: Dain
day3_dain_weekend_hesitate.text: *Dain slaps my shoulder* "It's fine! Just come sit and watch! One look at my spike and you'll be wide awake, trust me!"

day3_dain_weekend_choice.name: Me
day3_dain_weekend_choice.text: *Dain looks at me with eyes full of anticipation.*
choices: Alright! Saturday 9 AM at the gym.
Let me think about it and text you.
Sorry, I've got something else this weekend...

day3_dain_weekend_yes.name: Dain
day3_dain_weekend_yes.text: *Dain pumps both fists in the air* "YES!! Then I'll see you Saturday!! Stand me up and I will actually cry, got it?!"

day3_dain_weekend_later.name: Dain
day3_dain_weekend_later.text: *Dain puffs out her cheeks* "Ugh... you better come, okay? It's a promise!!"

day3_dain_weekend_no.name: Dain
day3_dain_weekend_no.text: *Dain's expression dims* "...Oh. I see. Well, next time for sure!"

day3_walk_with_nurse.name: Me
day3_walk_with_nurse.text: *I headed to the meeting spot. The Nurse is leaning against a wall, waiting.*

day3_walk_nurse_greet.name: Nurse
day3_walk_nurse_greet.text: "Oh my, you actually came? Hehe, what a well-mannered student. Come on, let's go."

day3_walk_nurse_arm.name: Me
day3_walk_nurse_arm.text: *She casually rests her hand on my arm as we walk side by side. What if someone sees...*

day3_walk_nurse_enjoy.name: Nurse
day3_walk_nurse_enjoy.text: *She smiles with satisfaction* "Hehe, you've got nerve. I like that."

day3_walk_nurse_worry.name: Nurse
day3_walk_nurse_worry.text: *She sighs softly and withdraws her hand* "You're right... it'd be trouble if we got caught."

day3_walk_nurse_conflict.name: Nurse
day3_walk_nurse_conflict.text: *Lost in thought* "...{name}. A teacher shouldn't be doing this with a student. But I just can't help myself."

day3_walk_nurse_conflict_2.name: Me
day3_walk_nurse_conflict_2.text: *There's a seriousness in her voice I've never heard before.*

day3_walk_nurse_confess.name: Nurse
day3_walk_nurse_confess.text: "...You're a dangerous one, aren't you? Don't go shaking a teacher's heart like this."

day3_walk_nurse_hand.name: Nurse
day3_walk_nurse_hand.text: *She looks at my hand in surprise... then squeezes back* "...Just five seconds. Let's stay like this for just five seconds."

day3_walk_nurse_boundary.name: Nurse
day3_walk_nurse_boundary.text: *Her expression freezes for a moment, then shifts to a smile* "...Right. A teacher is still a teacher."

day3_walk_nurse_freetalk.name: Me
day3_walk_nurse_freetalk.text: *Walking to school with the Nurse. A strange mix of tension and excitement.*
day3_walk_nurse_freetalk.context: Walking to school with the Nurse. She said 'a teacher shouldn't be doing this with a student,' revealing her inner conflict. A forbidden-romance tension in the air.
day3_walk_nurse_freetalk.personality: The Nurse is playful, alluring, and mature. She's torn between her feelings for the student and her ethics as a teacher.

day3_walk_nurse_talk.name: Nurse
day3_walk_nurse_talk.text: *As the school gate comes into view, she switches to a bright tone* "{name}. Got any plans this weekend?"
choices: Hmm... what did you have in mind?

day3_nurse_weekend_ask.name: Nurse
day3_nurse_weekend_ask.text: *She smiles meaningfully* "I've got a reservation at a nice restaurant for Sunday evening. Too good to waste going alone. How about 7 PM?"

day3_nurse_weekend_curious.name: Nurse
day3_nurse_weekend_curious.text: *She gives a playful wink* "There's a restaurant I reserved, and I want you to come with me. Sunday evening, 7 PM?"

day3_nurse_weekend_none.name: Nurse
day3_nurse_weekend_none.text: *She smiles contentedly* "Really? Then let's grab dinner together Sunday. Meet at 7, I'll send you the address."

day3_nurse_weekend_choice.name: Me
day3_nurse_weekend_choice.text: *She looks at me with that captivating gaze.*
choices: I'd love to! I'll definitely be there Sunday.
Let me think about it and tell you later.
Sorry, I have other plans this weekend...

day3_nurse_weekend_yes.name: Nurse
day3_nurse_weekend_yes.text: *She gives my hand a light squeeze, then lets go* "Hehe, then Sunday evening, 7 PM. Dress sharp."

day3_nurse_weekend_later.name: Nurse
day3_nurse_weekend_later.text: *She looks a little disappointed* "Oh? Then come by the nurse's office at lunch. Let's talk more."

day3_nurse_weekend_no.name: Nurse
day3_nurse_weekend_no.text: *Her smile stiffens slightly* "...Really? That's a shame."

day3_walk_with_teacher.name: Me
day3_walk_with_teacher.text: *I headed to the meeting spot. Teacher is waving at me from inside her car.*

day3_walk_teacher_greet.name: Teacher
day3_walk_teacher_greet.text: "{name}, good morning. Having company on the commute feels reassuring somehow. Here, seatbelt."

day3_walk_teacher_car.name: Me
day3_walk_teacher_car.text: *I got in. A faint coffee aroma and soft music. Oddly thrilling, this commute.*

day3_walk_teacher_hair.name: Teacher
day3_walk_teacher_hair.text: *At a red light, she suddenly reaches over and smooths down my hair* "...Wait. You've got a strand sticking out."

day3_walk_teacher_hair_2.name: Teacher
day3_walk_teacher_hair_2.text: *She pulls her hand back, murmuring* "...A teacher shouldn't be doing this to a student."

day3_walk_teacher_conflict.name: Me
day3_walk_teacher_conflict.text: *Her touch is warm. The air inside the car shifts to something different.*

day3_walk_teacher_warm.name: Teacher
day3_walk_teacher_warm.text: *She flinches and pulls her hand away* "Goodness... are you teasing your teacher?"

day3_walk_teacher_hold.name: Teacher
day3_walk_teacher_hold.text: *She stares at my hand in surprise... but doesn't pull away* "...When the light changes, you have to let go. Promise."

day3_walk_teacher_calm.name: Teacher
day3_walk_teacher_calm.text: *She smiles, a little wistfully* "...Thank you. I was being a bit strange, wasn't I?"

day3_walk_teacher_freetalk.name: Me
day3_walk_teacher_freetalk.text: *Riding in Teacher's car on the way to school together.*
day3_walk_teacher_freetalk.context: In Teacher's car on the way to school. She smoothed down his hair and said 'a teacher shouldn't be doing this to a student.' A forbidden-romance tension hangs in the air.
day3_walk_teacher_freetalk.personality: Teacher has a dry sense of humor. Seems blunt on the surface, but there's a gap when she catches herself having feelings for a student.

day3_walk_teacher_talk.name: Teacher
day3_walk_teacher_talk.text: *Carefully, while driving* "Hey, {name}. Are you free this weekend?"
choices: Hmm... what did you have in mind?

day3_teacher_weekend_ask.name: Teacher
day3_teacher_weekend_ask.text: *She glances over briefly* "I ended up with two tickets to a museum exhibition. Too good to waste going alone. How about Sunday at 2 PM?"

day3_teacher_weekend_curious.name: Teacher
day3_teacher_weekend_curious.text: "There's a museum exhibition I have tickets for, and I'd like company. Sunday, 2 PM?"

day3_teacher_weekend_none.name: Teacher
day3_teacher_weekend_none.text: *Her face lights up* "Really? Then Sunday afternoon, museum exhibition. 2 PM at the main entrance."

day3_teacher_weekend_choice.name: Me
day3_teacher_weekend_choice.text: *She steals a hopeful glance in my direction.*
choices: I'd love to! I'll definitely be there Sunday.
Let me think about it and tell you later.

day3_teacher_weekend_yes.name: Teacher
day3_teacher_weekend_yes.text: *Her face breaks into a bright smile* "Really? Then Sunday, 2 PM. Don't forget."

day3_teacher_weekend_later.name: Teacher
day3_teacher_weekend_later.text: *She looks a little disappointed* "Oh? Then let's talk about it later."

day3_teacher_weekend_no.name: Teacher
day3_teacher_weekend_no.text: *Her expression hardens* "...I see. Maybe I got my hopes up too much."

day3_prepare_school.name: Me
day3_prepare_school.text: *I rushed to get ready for school.*

day3_prepare_school_ads.name: Me
day3_prepare_school_ads.text: *'Limited-time deal!' 'Congratulations, you've won!'* ...All spam. Guess I'm walking alone today.

day3_walk_alone.name: Me
day3_walk_alone.text: *I headed to school alone. The morning air is cool and crisp.*

day3_arrive_school.name: Me
day3_arrive_school.text: *Arrived at the school gate. Another day begins.*

day3_classroom.name: Me
day3_classroom.text: *I walk into the classroom, already buzzing with chatter. As I move to sit down... there's something on my desk.*

day3_classroom_note_seoyeon.name: Me
day3_classroom_note_seoyeon.text: *A small note. 'Let's eat lunch together. - Seoyeon' ...We were just together and she already planted this in advance?*

day3_classroom_note_yuna.name: Me
day3_classroom_note_yuna.text: *An origami crow. Unfolding its wings reveals a message inside: '...tomorrow night' -- Must be from Yuna.*

day3_classroom_note_dain.name: Me
day3_classroom_note_dain.text: *An energy bar and a sticky note. 'If you're not gonna exercise, at least eat this!! - Dain' ...She planted this ahead of time.*

day3_classroom_empty.name: Me
day3_classroom_empty.text: *Nothing on the desk. Just an ordinary Friday.*

day3_classroom_class_start.name: Me
day3_classroom_class_start.text: *Class begins. Teacher writes on the board.*

day3_classroom_teacher_event.name: Me
day3_classroom_teacher_event.text: *When she reaches up to write at the top of the board, a subtle fragrance drifts over. I think I'm the only one who noticed.*

day3_classroom_teacher_wink.name: Teacher
day3_classroom_teacher_wink.text: *While asking a question, her eyes meet mine and she gives the faintest smile* "...{name}, what's the answer?"

day3_classroom_teacher_glance.name: Me
day3_classroom_teacher_glance.text: *She glances my way for a second and flashes a tiny smile. Is she thinking about our Sunday plans?*

day3_classroom_nurse_visit.name: Me
day3_classroom_nurse_visit.text: *Mid-class, the classroom door opens and the Nurse walks in.*

day3_classroom_nurse_visit_2.name: Nurse
day3_classroom_nurse_visit_2.text: "Excuse me, I'm here to hand out health survey forms."

day3_classroom_nurse_visit_3.name: Me
day3_classroom_nurse_visit_3.text: *The Nurse hands out surveys and pauses at my desk. Our fingertips barely touch.*

day3_classroom_nurse_secret.name: Nurse
day3_classroom_nurse_secret.text: *Without anyone noticing, she slips a note between the survey pages. 'Come to the nurse's office at lunch. I've got something special for you.'*

day3_classroom_nurse_band.name: Nurse
day3_classroom_nurse_band.text: *While handing me the survey, she sticks a bandage on the back of my hand* "...You don't have a cut, do you? It's just... a teacher's mark."

day3_classroom_nurse_pass.name: Me
day3_classroom_nurse_pass.text: *The Nurse hands me the survey with a gentle smile.*

day3_classroom_nurse_leave.name: Me
day3_classroom_nurse_leave.text: *The Nurse leaves the classroom. Nobody noticed a thing.*

day3_break_time.name: Me
day3_break_time.text: *Break time. I check my phone and see some messages about the weekend.*

day3_weekend_invite_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day3_weekend_invite_seoyeon.text: *Message* '{name}, want to check out a new cafe with me Saturday? I want to go with you.'
choices: Sorry, I'm kind of busy this weekend

day3_weekend_yes_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day3_weekend_yes_seoyeon.text: *Instant reply* 'Done. See you Saturday. Feel free to get excited.'

day3_weekend_no_seoyeon.name: Seoyeon
day3_weekend_no_seoyeon.text: *Reply, much later* '...Fine. We can always go another time.'

day3_weekend_invite_yuna.name: Yuna
day3_weekend_invite_yuna.text: *Message* '...Saturday night, 8 PM. Storage shed behind the school. Come alone.'
choices: Got it. I'll definitely be there.

day3_weekend_invite_dain.name: Dain
day3_weekend_invite_dain.text: *Message* '{name}!! Wanna work out with me at the gym Saturday?! See you at 9!!'

day3_weekend_yes_dain.name: Dain
day3_weekend_yes_dain.text: *Reply in 0.3 seconds* 'YAAAY!! The best!! Bring workout clothes!!'

day3_weekend_no_dain.name: Dain
day3_weekend_no_dain.text: *Reply* 'Aww~ too bad! Next time for sure!!'

day3_weekend_invite_nurse.name: Nurse
day3_weekend_invite_nurse.text: *Message* 'Free Sunday evening? There's a restaurant I want to take you to~'
choices: I'd love to! I'll be there for sure.

day3_weekend_yes_nurse.name: Nurse
day3_weekend_yes_nurse.text: *Reply* 'Hehe, I'll be looking forward to it. Sunday evening, 7 PM~'

day3_weekend_no_nurse.name: Nurse
day3_weekend_no_nurse.text: *Reply* 'That's a shame... let's definitely go together next time.'

day3_weekend_invite_teacher.name: Teacher
day3_weekend_invite_teacher.text: *Message* '{name}, there's a special exhibition at the city museum this Sunday. Want to go together? No extra credit for this.'
choices: I'd love to! I'll be there for sure.

day3_set_multiple_dates.name: Me
day3_set_multiple_dates.text: *......Wait. I have multiple weekend plans? How is this going to work?*

day3_morning_end.name: Me
day3_morning_end.text: *Classes continue... and before I know it, it's lunchtime.*
